document_metadata.document_type: Mainframe Batch To .NET 8 Target Design Specification

source_system_summary.processing_description: Extract every account to three sequential formats and list it on SYSOUT.

business_rules.statement: Each account is displayed field by field on SYSOUT.
OUTFILE carries the account with CURR-CYC-DEBIT packed (COMP-3); 2525.00 is moved only when the debit is zero.
The reissue date is reformatted by the assembler routine COBDATFT (type 2 in, type 2 out: YYYY-MM-DD -> YYYYMMDD).
ARRYFILE: occurrence 1 and 2 copy the balance with debits 1005.00 / 1525.00; occurrence 3 is -1025.00 / -2500.00.
VBRCFILE receives a 12-byte and a 39-byte variable record per account.

gaps.description: COBDATFT is HLASM (app/asm/COBDATFT.asm) and is not built into the GnuCOBOL loadlib, so READACCT cannot run on the harness; the .NET port follows the assembler source (VALIDIN2 path) and is proven by unit tests, not by golden files.
OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT is only moved when the debit is zero; otherwise the FD buffer keeps the previous record's value. The .NET port reproduces 'carry previous value' (initial value 0).
Plugin numeric convention prescribes MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero; the legacy source has no ROUNDED and golden fixtures prove truncation (i02-tie-half-cent). Legacy truncation is kept (ADR-003).
